mapper.select: SELECT a.attname AS column_name, col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum) AS description, pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, null) AS type, CASE WHEN pg_index.indkey::text LIKE '%' || a.attnum::text || '%' THEN true ELSE false END AS is_primary_key FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid LEFT JOIN pg_index ON pg_index.indrelid = c.oid AND pg_index.indisprimary WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND a.attnum > 0 AND a.atttypid != 0 AND c.relname = #{tableName} ORDER BY a . attnum;

SELECT relname AS table_name, obj_description(relfilenode, 'pg_class') AS description from pg_class WHERE relkind = 'r' and relnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'public') ORDER BY table_name
select a.attname AS cloumn_name from pg_index i join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = i.indrelid and a.attnum = any (i.indkey) where i.indrelid = '"${tableName}"'::regclass and i.indisprimary
